newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB launches home loan in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB launches home loan in Hong Kong.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Tuesday it was launching a home loan product in Hong Kong, making it the first Australian bank to do so in the British territory.

"The Tailored Home Loan has been adapted for home buyers in Hong Kong from a formula that has been extraordinarily successful for (NAB) in other markets," group general manager, USA and Asia, Bob Prowse said in a statement.
The product had helped NAB increase its market share in every year since 1990, he added.

The Tailored Home Loan launch was part of the group's overall Asian strategy, which would see it active in the mortgage, deposit, unit trust and insurance sectors as well as wholesale banking, Prowse said.
"Our expansion in the region will see the opening of additional branches and representative offices," he said.
The bank planned to introduce the newly-launched loan product to U.S. markets through its Michigan National Bank unit in early 1997.
